spec.units: carry_share = share of this month's absolute repair motion carried by names that also repaired the previous month; jaccard = overlap of the two months' repair-name sets; values are bp (x1e4 of the month's weight-return term)

answers.verdict: carriers persist: the same names repair month after month, so the between-month reversal is one set of names moving

honest: carry_share is computed on the CURRENT month's absolute motion, so a persistent but tiny carrier cannot inflate the number
a month where nothing repaired is not a recycling month: the pair is skipped and counted in pairs_unmeasured
Jaccard ignores magnitude, so a persistent giant and a persistent minnow count the same; persistent_carrier_share_pct is the magnitude-weighted reading published beside it
the persistent-carrier rule needs a name in >=50% of the era's REPAIRING months, which is a book-relative majority and not an absolute month count
descriptive census only: n here is month pairs, not trials, and no gate, prereg or trial count is implied

the E187 face was published at an earlier cutoff, so the head-to-head abs_diff includes the panel moving under it; the same-construct control recomputes E187's own formula at THIS cutoff and is the reading that proves the arithmetic rather than the vintage
